capabilities: Generate one Markdown note per coin issue and mint variant
Synchronize official issues and prices from Numista
Filter, sort and group the coin grid by country, year and ownership
Download, crop and convert coin covers to WebP
Export missing, owned and swap lists to Markdown and CSV
extras: Numista synchronization needs an API key and is rate-limited (HTTP 429); the README advises backing up the vault before bulk sync, title normalization or cover migration. Interface available in English, Polish, German and French.
problem: Collectors of 2 euro coins have no structured way inside Obsidian to record which issues they own, what they are worth and which covers they use.

relations.evidence: Synchronizes official 2 euro issues from Numista.

summary: Coin catalogue plugin that stores each 2 euro issue as a Markdown note with a filterable dashboard, ownership tracking and Numista sync.
